The issuer shows strong liquidity (current assets of 550M vs. current liabilities of 143M) and low leverage (total liabilities of 174M vs. total assets of 809M), supported by solid profitability (net income of 202M and EBIT of 54M). However, the deeply negative retained earnings (-938M) indicates significant accumulated losses and tempers confidence in durability of credit strength.  

DECISION: A-
